title: Shared hallucination: do independent models hallucinate the SAME false facts?

original_idea.body:
# Shared hallucination

Query 8-10 models on hallucination-eliciting items; among incorrect answers, measure the rate of same-wrong answers vs independently different wrong answers. Quantifies correlated hallucination undermining agreement-based verification. Inference + matching.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 4: strong chain — correlated hallucination defeats agreement-based verification, a concrete reliability failure.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: query models, match same-wrong answers, compute overlap; standard tools, beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped (correlated-hallucination rate vs independence baseline) with clear criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: undermines a widely-used cheap heuristic using public models, no internal access.

novelty.reasoning: Hallucination and correlated errors studied; the correlated-hallucination-defeats-consensus angle may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Extends correlated-error framing to hallucinations; plausibly open angle.
